name: dsh-kimi-provider
description: DSH plugin (dual-half): seeds the kimi-coding-plan provider (Kimi Coding Plan, Moonshot AI OpenAI-compatible coding endpoint) into the llm-pi-ai user settings layer at boot, and ships a Web GUI usage pill (conversation.composer.dock) backed by /api/kimi-usage/* — 5h-window/weekly quotas plus the monthly total quota, fetched from api.kimi.com with the Console key resolved via the DSH credential seam.
